data.narrative:
Dendra Systems is a Series A-stage climate and energy company that has raised $18M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 1 public comparable (Linz AG, ticker LNZA) and 8 private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers—zero datapoints met the narrow-filter threshold of three or more—making traditional peer-median benchmarking inapplicable.

The valuation triangulation therefore relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $18M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $36M. This method assumes comparable deployment efficiency and investor confidence relative to frontier-tech sector norms at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $31M to $41M, centered on a median of $36M. This reflects ±15% variance around the base calculation. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrowly comparable Series A peers in climate technology, limiting confidence in the stage multiplier assumption, and the early-stage risk profile inherent to frontier applications. Additional diligence on burn rate, technology differentiation, and market timing relative to sector funding cycles would refine this range.
